inventory: one row per non-OOS image_id; doorway kept separately; quality gates do not remove marking-study inventory
primary_unit: 116 existing registered ABC events, n13/m5; each direction 58 events on the same 29 images and 6 buildings
nested_unit: 4 fixed-block paths with ABC arms, one fixed entrant order per path; 195 adjacent arm-level n-to-n+1 comparisons
group_id: local to each team; never align across teams by node number
group_alignment: connected components through shared exact original observations; one-to-one/split/merge/many-to-many/unlinked recorded separately
retained_partition_changed: partitions of exact observations belonging to common workers differ; includes unselected groups, not necessarily semantic identity error or output change
threshold_only_losses: count of one-to-one selected-to-unselected groups with unchanged support and a raised threshold; other groups/centers may also change
new_vote_gains: count of one-to-one unselected-to-selected groups with increased support; not proof of semantic correctness
class_semantics: frozen Rnew2 actual replacement geometry classes; not semantic detail-retainer/simplifier labels
local_pattern: both/one/neither of two explicitly listed local identity groups in Uw22; neither does not certify intentional simplification
scores: original B8L2/D10 parameters and exact bound reference; score missing remains null; no zero imputation
coordinates: continuous ERP 1024x512 processed points; no re-preprocessing, scaling fit or reference-directed fusion
direct_edge_support: people whose unfiltered assigned original ring contains that adjacent identity pair
projected_edge_support: people whose ring after deleting nonselected nodes contains that adjacent pair; not direct-edge votes
frozen_identity_control: rethreshhold old groups at new N; coordinates/ring fixed; entrant unassigned, so this is a mechanism control, not an alternative full new-team fusion
local_review_control: all17-person observations and denominator retained; only the reviewed old13 observations regrouped; remaining groups re-estimated with the same median and MV50; connected by the same source-ring rule; human-assisted diagnostic, not automatic success
counts: event counts, group counts, real image/building counts and unique teams reported separately; cases overlap previous work
population_inference: descriptive fixed panel; no universal failure rate, no future-worker claim
